info.title: OPSIB Retail Exception & Reliability Engine
info.description: Operational intelligence backend for retail data integration, exception detection, and workforce task routing with server-enforced state machine and idempotent retry resilience.

post.summary: Ingest raw dataset (CSV, JSON, or Multipart File)
post.description: Validates, deduplicates, and normalizes records for the specified dataset into canonical storage. Supports application/json (list of records or {'records': [...]}), multipart/form-data, and text/csv.

get.description: Retrieves processing counts, errors, and status for an import batch.

Retrieves unresolved data quality issues, unmapped crosswalks, and conflicting duplicates.
Keeps bad or ambiguous data visible without contaminating business exception reporting.

parameters.name: issue_type

schema.description: Filter by issue type (e.g. UNMAPPED_CROSSWALK, CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE)
schema.title: Issue Type

parameters.description: Filter by issue type (e.g. UNMAPPED_CROSSWALK, CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE)

schema.title: Response Get Data Quality Issues Api V1 Data Quality Get

post.summary: Trigger deterministic reconciliation against frozen evaluation time
post.description: Runs the shortfall detection engine against all canonical PO lines using the frozen evaluation clock (2026-10-16T15:00:00+05:30). Also auto-creates HumanTasks for each new exception with workforce routing. This endpoint is idempotent: repeated calls will not create duplicate exceptions or tasks.

get.summary: List operational exceptions with optional filters
get.description: Return all operational exceptions, optionally filtered.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Filter by exception status (e.g. DETECTED, RESOLVED)
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Filter by exception status (e.g. DETECTED, RESOLVED)

get.summary: Retrieve a single exception by ID with detailed context
get.description: Returns the exception alongside its canonical purchase order line, matching goods receipts, and active workforce task.

get.summary: Task detail with full audit history

post.summary: Complete task with resolution (IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED). Idempotent on retry.
Submit completed task for verification (COMPLETED -> PENDING_VERIFICATION)
Verify task and close exception (PENDING_VERIFICATION -> VERIFIED)

post.description: Assigns a task currently in CREATED status to an eligible employee.

post.summary: Reassign task to a different employee
post.description: Permitted from ASSIGNED, ACKNOWLEDGED, or IN_PROGRESS states (and CREATED).

post.summary: Generate a grounded AI advisory investigation brief for an exception
post.description: Invokes the AI copilot (powered by OpenRouter or deterministic mock) to analyze the evidence package for the specified operational exception. Strictly advisory: does NOT mutate database records, does NOT calculate authoritative quantities, and strips ungrounded or hallucinated citations via safety guardrails.

schema.description: Explicitly force mock provider (defaults to mock if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is unset)
